checked_claims.claim: Edition, player count, designer, duration and components
checked_claims.detail: 2014 dlp English base edition, 2–4 players, Reiner Stockhausen and listed component counts agree. Official publisher metadata corroborates 90 minutes only; its present player-count listing was not imported.

Starting four marked Followers on Market, Merchant in Orléans, 5 coins, 10 stations, 7 markers, initial track positions, 13 Citizens plus final award, neutral supplies, shuffled face-up map goods, remaining Goods Market, category stacks, top Pilgrimage, all 2/3-player follower and goods removals, and excluded goods spaces agree.

checked_claims.claim: Round count, order, Census and draws
checked_claims.detail: 18 complete rounds; seven phases; youngest initial Start Player; leftward rotation; Farmer-track Census with tied ranks and 2-player exemption; optional draw up to Knight allowance and Market capacity, initially four; retained Market tiles agree.

Matching spaces, gradual activation, future-round saving, clockwise one-action/pass turns, final passing, ordinary used Followers to bag and Technology remaining, and unused/incomplete activations remaining agree. Phase-3 recovery spends forgone draws, with no direct Action-Space-to-Action-Space reassignment.

checked_claims.claim: Farm House printed cost and effect
checked_claims.detail: Boatman + Craftsman. Recruit Farmer to bag; advance track and take depicted good.
Farmer + Boatman + Craftsman. Choose one Boatman/Craftsman/Trader recruitment, not all three.
Farmer + Craftsman + Trader. Recruit Scholar to bag, advance Scholars Track and receive depicted Development Points.
Farmer + Boatman + Trader. Recruit Knight to bag and advance draw track; fourth Knight remains allowance 7 and first arrival gains Citizen.
Scholar + Trader. Recruit Monk to bag, without extra track reward.
Farmer + Boatman + Knight. Move one Waterway to adjacent town; optional one good from connection.
Farmer + Trader + Knight. Move one Road to adjacent town; optional one good from connection.
Farmer + Craftsman + Knight. Build at Merchant town; one station total per town except one per player in Orléans.
Knight + Scholar. Gain one Development Point.

checked_claims.claim: Town Hall printed cost and effect
checked_claims.detail: Any 1 or 2 neutral Followers. One space suffices; send selected one/both permanently to exact free Deed professions, possibly different Deeds; placement rewards and completion Citizen; no marked starting Followers.

checked_claims.claim: Village track rewards, Technology and acquired Places
checked_claims.detail: Boatman coins with first-player final Citizen instead; Craftsman Technology usable only after passing; Trader first category I then I/II, with newly owned ability available immediately; newly completed action still obeys activation and turn order. Last-track-space recruitment prohibition agrees.

First placed Technology replaces Farmer; subsequent non-Monk profession, at most one per Place, never on single-Follower Places, fixed after placement. Monks substitute for ordinary other professions, with no reverse substitution.
Farmer. One grain from Goods Market.

checked_claims.claim: Cheese Factory printed cost and effect
checked_claims.detail: Farmer + Farmer. One cheese from Goods Market.
Farmer + Trader. One wine from Goods Market.

checked_claims.claim: Wool Manufacturer printed cost and effect
checked_claims.detail: Boatman + Trader. One wool from Goods Market.

checked_claims.claim: Tailor Shop printed cost and effect
checked_claims.detail: Scholar + Trader. One brocade from Goods Market.

checked_claims.claim: Shipping Line printed cost and effect
checked_claims.detail: Boatman. One Development Point.
Monk. Two coins.
Craftsman + Craftsman. Two coins and one Development Point.
Knight + Scholar. Two Development Points.
Any one Follower. Pay 1–3 coins, advancing one Development space per coin; minimum one.
Monk + Scholar. Four coins.
Scholar + Scholar. One coin per built Trading Station.
Boatman + Scholar. Coins equal to current Development Status.

checked_claims.claim: Horse Wagon printed cost and effect
checked_claims.detail: Trader + Knight. Move one Road to adjacent town and collect one good if available.
Scholar + Craftsman. One Technology; normal placement constraints, including no first Technology here because neither space is Farmer, and a later tile may be placed on Laboratory.

Farmer. Original 2014 draw-three/choose-two: immediate legal Action-Space placement, never Bathhouse, activating Follower and unplaced draws returned to bag; place only one/none when two cannot be placed.
Monk. Activated protection against a negative event, spending Monk into bag during Phase 6 instead of suffering event.

checked_claims.claim: Herb Garden printed cost and effect
checked_claims.detail: No activation. Ongoing Boatman substitution for Craftsman, Trader and Farmer; does not override exact Deed professions.
No activation. Ongoing Scholar substitution for non-Monk professions; does not override exact Deed professions.

checked_claims.claim: Gunpowder Tower printed cost and effect
checked_claims.detail: No ordinary activation. Two extra Market spaces, Phase-3 Followers there, Planning transfer one/both to actions or Action-Phase direct Deed donation of one/both in one action; marked Followers ineligible for donation.

checked_claims.claim: Development, end condition, scoring and ties
checked_claims.detail: Move one space per Development Point; onto/past coin and first-player Citizen rewards and Status changes; finish final round including event; unique-most built stations Citizen; coin and goods values 1/2/3/4/5; (built stations + Citizens) times Status; tied VP resolved by Development Track then shared victory agree.

checked_claims.claim: All six events and their destinations/exceptions
checked_claims.detail: Three of each event; Pilgrimage bars Monk recruitment during Actions; Income by Status; Harvest grain/cheese/wine returned to Goods Market or mandatory 5-coin fallback then torture; Taxes per complete three goods; Trading Day per built station; Plague random bag Follower to recruitable supply, no track retreat, marked draw loses nobody and is not redrawn.

checked_claims.claim: Torture, finite supplies and general procedures
checked_claims.detail: Each missing coin may be replaced with any mix of listed items; random neutral bag Followers only, marked redrawn; built/unbuilt stations eligible; Development retreat cannot reach/pass coin spaces; lost items removed from game, only Development Points regainable. Missing Character/Technology/Goods prevents whole providing action; Harvest/Plague restore availability. Insufficient coins prevent receipts. Bag inspection requires subsequent shuffle; payments from/to common supply and clockwise order agree.

checked_claims.claim: Narrow base Town Hall same/separate-actions clarification
checked_claims.source: base-clarification-invasion-2015.pdf p.3 explicit Town Hall cross-reference; p.24 publisher credit; matching-rulebook.pdf p.15
checked_claims.detail: Publisher 2015 text explicitly compares Town Hall with using any/all placed Followers in one or separate actions. Summary restricts its FAQ to separate action turns in the same Action Phase before passing. This cross-reference was not used to establish cross-round fate after a partially used Town Hall, and no scenario procedures were imported.

audit_scope.base_rules: 2014 dlp English base pp.12–21, all 20 base Place Tiles pp.22–23, components/credit p.24
audit_scope.method: Independent full scoped source-text read plus visual inspection of the rendered base pages and action/Place icons. The verification banner was not treated as evidence. No questions, answer keys, reader output, material-fact files, previous audits, coverage reviews, adjudications, manifests or README were opened. No summary repairs authored.
audit_scope.excluded: Optional pregame Place exclusion and all expansion/scenario procedures. The 2015 booklet supports only the explicit base Town Hall same/separate-actions cross-reference and publisher credit. Publisher duration metadata supports only 90 minutes.
audit_scope.cross_round_partial_town_hall: Not established using the 2015 cross-reference; summary makes no specific cross-round ruling for a partially used Town Hall.
